title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR SPACE CONTROL.

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.quote: Pressure transducers (3,4) monitor internal and external conditions to provide inputs to a monitoring circuit.
features.note: The reference discloses pressure transducers monitoring internal conditions, which is analogous to monitoring vacuum level in a sealed region.
features.refuted: The quote mentions pressure transducers monitoring internal and external conditions, but does not specify that they are monitoring vacuum level in a sealed region.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.quote: The detector circuit responds to trigger an alarm.
features.note: The reference discloses an alarm triggered by a change in conditions, but not specifically a vacuum falling to a threshold above a release level.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord

overall.why: The reference describes a pressure-based alarm system but for space control rather than vacuum lifting, with only a few very general features overlapping.
